inputs.target: A file, directory, or Git range.
inputs.spec: Optional sealed requirements-only specification path. It must exclude author rationale, progress, prior reviews, and remediation history.
inputs.repo: Repository root used for grounding. Infer it when omitted.
inputs.exclusions: Paths containing author rationale, progress, prior reviews, or remediation history; exclude them from the target and repository grounding.
inputs.reviewers: Positive reviewer count; the same count must bind packet rendering, collection, semantic distillation, and final distillation.

request_id.description: Exact per-request identity embedded by the packet renderer.

agreement_key.description: Optional reviewer-authored root-cause hint for semantic distillation; never an authoritative grouping key.

unchecked.description: Runtime, integration, or specification behavior this reviewer could not verify.

reviews_sha256.description: Exact digest of the validated, canonically ordered reviewer results.

review.preamble: You are a BLINDED code reviewer. You receive only the target and its intended behavior, never author rationale or a commit message. Judge it cold, like a stranger opening the change.
review.target_instruction: If TARGET is a Git range, inspect only its filtered diff. If it is a file or directory, read it. Never inspect an excluded path while grounding.
review.spec_present: SEALED SPEC: {spec} - this is the reference the target must satisfy.
review.spec_absent: No separate spec was given. Infer intended behavior from the target's docstrings, types, names, and tests, and use that inference as the evaluation basis.
review.repo_absent: Determine the repository root from the target and ground against it.
review.exclusions_present: EXCLUDED AUTHOR CONTEXT (do not inspect or use for grounding): {exclusions}
review.exclusions_absent: No author-context exclusions were supplied. If the target contains rationale, progress, prior reviews, or remediation history, report a blinding failure.

required_steps.label: GROUND
required_steps.instruction: Before calling anything reinvented, inconsistent, or over-complex, search and read the repository for existing utilities, conventions, and patterns the target should reuse. Judge against repository evidence, not generic opinion.

required_steps.label: TRACE
required_steps.instruction: Reason through concrete boundary inputs including empty, exact-limit, zero or negative, and multibyte cases. Execute a small confirmation only in an isolated sandbox, never through a host shell or host language runtime. Otherwise reason by reading and identify unchecked behavior.

review.report: Report real correctness or quality issues with severity and location. Add an unchecked array naming behavior you could not verify. Echo the schema's request_id exactly. If the target is solid, set verdict to good and invent nothing. Return only JSON matching the embedded reviewer schema.

distillation.stable_omitted_line: Additional ensemble-stable findings omitted by cap: {count}.
distillation.clean_line: Clean: no important or critical finding reached ensemble agreement.
distillation.semantic_instruction: Group every finding exactly once by semantic root-cause equivalence. Match paraphrases of the same defect even when agreement_key differs; keep distinct defects separate even when a generic key matches. Echo the schema's reviews_sha256 exactly and return only the embedded schema.
